sloka: सुग्रीवो अपि व्यनदद् घोरम् वालिनो ह्वान कारणात् ।गाढम् परिहितो वेगान् नादैः भिन्दन् इव अंबरम् ॥४-१२-१५॥
transliteration: sugrīvo api vyanadad ghoram vālino hvāna kāraṇāt ।gāḍham parihito vegān nādaiḥ bhindan iva aṁbaram ॥4-12-15॥

translations.english: Sugriva tightened up his waist cloth hurriedly and roared terrifically as though piercing the sky. And screamed for Vali.
